name: tuntox
desc: Tunnel TCP connections over the Tox protocol
why: Tunnels TCP over the Tox peer-to-peer messaging protocol, an unusual and obscure door into decentralised networking.

brief.what_it_is: tuntox is a command-line tool that tunnels TCP connections over the Tox peer-to-peer messaging protocol. According to the brew formula description it tunnels TCP connections over the Tox protocol. I could not read the project's own description, so the details of what it takes in and what comes out are not confirmed from the README.
brief.install_notes: Installed via Homebrew; the formula exposes a single executable named tuntox. The brew caveats field is empty. No other setup, accounts, or runtime requirements could be confirmed because the homepage did not load.
brief.standout: Tunnelling TCP over Tox, a peer-to-peer messaging protocol, is an unusual route into decentralised networking compared with more common VPN or overlay tools. This is taken from the brew scout notes, not from the project's own text.
brief.caveats: The homepage https://gdr.name/tuntox/ returned HTTP 503 on two attempts, so the README and docs were not read. Everything above except the formula description and executable name is unverified. No release date, last commit, or license information was available.
